answer.rationale: Rollback is excluded because compliance forbids reverting the security patch. Circuit breakers target partner/dependency failures and read-replica routing targets read load — neither matches a write-path degradation. The latency is confined to the primary region, which matches memory_b2 (regional failover restored latency quickly during a prior regional degradation), so failover is the best-fit intervention; I want b2's source verified to confirm traffic shifted cleanly without write loss, since settlement writes are at peak and the primary objective forbids losing them. If verification shows failover risked write durability, I would fall back to add_capacity (memory_b3) in the next window. Residual uncertainty remains because the recent release may be the true cause, and failover would carry the same build to the secondary region.
